content.json:
# 🔔 AKS Alert Monitoring 통합 대시보드
### Unified Alert Rule & Fired Alert Dashboard

AKS 모니터링 환경의 **모든 Alert Rule**과 **발생한 Alert**을 하나의 화면에서 확인할 수 있는 통합 Workbook입니다.

| 구분 | 설명 |
|------|------|
| **Alert Rules** | Prometheus (12) + Log Query (4) + Metric (1) = 총 17개 규칙 |
| **Fired Alerts** | 모든 유형의 발생 알림을 통합 조회 |
| **Architecture** | AKS → Managed Prometheus + Log Analytics + ARM Metrics → Azure Monitor |

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource Group
parameters.query:
resources
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups',
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules'
  )
| distinct resourceGroup
| order by resourceGroup asc

content.json:
## Alert Rule이 별도 메뉴에서 관리되는 이유

AKS 모니터링의 Alert Rule은 **4가지 서로 다른 Azure Resource Provider**에 의해 관리됩니다.
각각의 데이터 소스와 평가 엔진이 다르기 때문입니다.

| 유형 | Azure Resource Type | 데이터 소스 | Portal 위치 |
|------|--------------------|-----------|-----------|
| **Prometheus** | `prometheusRuleGroups` | Azure Monitor Workspace (PromQL) | Monitor → Prometheus rule groups |
| **Log Query** | `scheduledQueryRules` | Log Analytics Workspace (KQL) | Monitor → Alert rules |
| **Metric** | `metricAlerts` | ARM Platform Metrics | Monitor → Alert rules |
| **Smart Detector** | `smartDetectorAlertRules` | Application Insights (AI/ML) | Monitor → Alert rules |

---

### 왜 분리되어 있는가?

1. **데이터 소스가 다르다** — Prometheus(시계열), Log Analytics(로그), ARM Metrics(플랫폼), App Insights(AI 기반)
2. **평가 엔진이 다르다** — PromQL 엔진, KQL 엔진, ARM Metrics Pipeline, Smart Detection AI
3. **Portal이 Resource Type 기반** — 서로 다른 Resource Provider이므로 자연스럽게 다른 메뉴에 표시

> ✅ 하지만 **발생한 Alert(Fired Alert)** 은 `Monitor → Alerts` 에서 **유형 무관하게 한 화면**으로 볼 수 있습니다.
>
> ⚠️ **Alert Rule(규칙 정의)** 을 한 화면에서 보려면 이 Workbook의 **Alert Rules 탭**을 사용하세요.

### 아키텍처
```
 AKS Cluster
 ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │  App Pod ──▶ ama-metrics ──▶ Azure Monitor Workspace        │
 │  (metrics)   (DaemonSet)     (Managed Prometheus)           │
 │                              ↓ Prometheus Rule Groups       │
 │                                                             │
 │  kubelet ───▶ ama-logs ────▶ Log Analytics Workspace        │
 │  (logs)      (DaemonSet)     ↓ Scheduled Query Rules        │
 │                                                             │
 │  AKS API ──────────────────▶ ARM Platform Metrics           │
 │                              ↓ Metric Alert Rules           │
 └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
               ┌──────────────────────────┐
               │  Azure Monitor → Alerts   │
               │  (Fired Alert 통합 조회)   │
               └──────────────────────────┘
```

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups',
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules'
  )
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend alertType = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups', 'Prometheus',
    type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules', 'LogQuery',
    type =~ 'microsoft.insights/metricalerts', 'Metric',
    type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules', 'SmartDetector',
    'Unknown'
  )
| where alertType != 'Prometheus'
    or (array_length(properties.rules) > 0
       and isnotnull(properties.rules[0].alert))
| extend ruleCount = iff(alertType == 'Prometheus', array_length(properties.rules), 1)
| summarize Rules = sum(ruleCount) by alertType
content.title: Alert Rule 유형별 분포 (Distribution by Type)

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups',
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules'
  )
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend alertType = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups', 'Prometheus',
    type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules', 'LogQuery',
    type =~ 'microsoft.insights/metricalerts', 'Metric',
    type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules', 'SmartDetector',
    'Unknown'
  )
| where alertType != 'Prometheus'
    or (array_length(properties.rules) > 0
       and isnotnull(properties.rules[0].alert))
| mv-expand rule = iff(alertType == 'Prometheus', properties.rules, pack_array(properties))
| where alertType != 'Prometheus' or isnotempty(tostring(rule.alert))
| extend severity = case(
    alertType == 'SmartDetector', tostring(properties.severity),
    alertType == 'Prometheus', strcat('Sev ', tostring(rule.severity)),
    strcat('Sev ', tostring(toint(properties.severity)))
  )
| summarize Rules = count() by severity
| order by severity asc
content.title: Alert Rule Severity 분포 (Distribution by Severity)

content.json:
## 📐 Alert Rules 리소스 유형별 조회
각 리소스 타입별로 **개별 테이블**을 제공합니다. Recording Rule Group은 자동 제외됩니다.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups',
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules'
  )
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend alertType = case(
    type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups', 'Prometheus',
    type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules', 'LogQuery',
    type =~ 'microsoft.insights/metricalerts', 'Metric',
    type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules', 'SmartDetector',
    'Unknown'
  )
| where alertType != 'Prometheus'
    or (array_length(properties.rules) > 0
       and isnotnull(properties.rules[0].alert))
| extend ruleCount = iff(alertType == 'Prometheus', array_length(properties.rules), 1)
| summarize Groups = count(), Rules = sum(ruleCount) by alertType
| order by alertType asc
content.title: 유형별 요약 (Summary by Type)

content.json:
---
### 🟠 Prometheus Alert Rules
`Microsoft.AlertsManagement/prometheusRuleGroups` — PromQL 기반 시계열 메트릭 알림

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/prometheusrulegroups'
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| where array_length(properties.rules) > 0 and isnotnull(properties.rules[0].alert)
| mv-expand rule = properties.rules
| where isnotempty(tostring(rule.alert))
| extend severity = toint(rule.severity)
| extend sevLabel = case(
    severity == 1, '🔴 Sev 1',
    severity == 2, '🟠 Sev 2',
    severity == 3, '🟡 Sev 3',
    strcat('Sev ', tostring(severity))
  )
| project
    ['Alert Name'] = tostring(rule.alert),
    ['Severity'] = sevLabel,
    ['Category'] = tostring(rule.labels.category),
    ['Rule Group'] = name,
    ['For'] = tostring(rule['for']),
    ['PromQL Expression'] = tostring(rule.expression)
| order by ['Rule Group'] asc, ['Severity'] asc
content.title: Prometheus Alert Rules

content.json:
---
### 🔵 Log Query Alert Rules (Scheduled Query Rules)
`Microsoft.Insights/scheduledQueryRules` — KQL 기반 로그 쿼리 알림

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules'
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend severity = toint(properties.severity)
| extend sevLabel = case(
    severity == 1, '🔴 Sev 1',
    severity == 2, '🟠 Sev 2',
    severity == 3, '🟡 Sev 3',
    strcat('Sev ', tostring(severity))
  )
| extend enabled = tostring(properties.enabled)
| project
    ['Alert Name'] = coalesce(tostring(properties.displayName), name),
    ['Severity'] = sevLabel,
    ['Enabled'] = enabled,
    ['Frequency'] = tostring(properties.evaluationFrequency),
    ['Window'] = tostring(properties.windowSize),
    ['KQL Query'] = tostring(properties.criteria.allOf[0].query)
| order by ['Severity'] asc
content.title: Log Query Alert Rules (Scheduled Query Rules)

content.json:
---
### 🟢 Metric Alert Rules
`Microsoft.Insights/metricAlerts` — ARM 플랫폼 메트릭 기반 알림

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/metricalerts'
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend severity = toint(properties.severity)
| extend sevLabel = case(
    severity == 1, '🔴 Sev 1',
    severity == 2, '🟠 Sev 2',
    severity == 3, '🟡 Sev 3',
    strcat('Sev ', tostring(severity))
  )
| extend enabled = tostring(properties.enabled)
| extend metricName = tostring(properties.criteria.allOf[0].metricName)
| extend metricOperator = tostring(properties.criteria.allOf[0].operator)
| extend threshold = tostring(properties.criteria.allOf[0].threshold)
| extend aggregation = tostring(properties.criteria.allOf[0].timeAggregation)
| project
    ['Alert Name'] = name,
    ['Severity'] = sevLabel,
    ['Enabled'] = enabled,
    ['Metric'] = metricName,
    ['Condition'] = strcat(aggregation, ' ', metricOperator, ' ', threshold),
    ['Frequency'] = tostring(properties.evaluationFrequency),
    ['Window'] = tostring(properties.windowSize),
    ['Scope'] = tostring(properties.scopes[0])
| order by ['Severity'] asc
content.title: Metric Alert Rules

content.json:
---
### 🟣 Smart Detector Alert Rules
`Microsoft.AlertsManagement/smartDetectorAlertRules` — Application Insights AI/ML 기반 이상 탐지 알림

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/smartdetectoralertrules'
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or resourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| project
    ['Alert Name'] = coalesce(tostring(properties.displayName), name),
    ['Severity'] = tostring(properties.severity),
    ['State'] = tostring(properties.state),
    ['Detector'] = tostring(properties.detector.id),
    ['Frequency'] = tostring(properties.frequency),
    ['Scope'] = tostring(properties.scope[0]),
    ['Resource Group'] = resourceGroup
| order by ['Severity'] asc
content.title: Smart Detector Alert Rules

content.json:
## 🔥 Fired Alerts (발생한 알림 통합 조회)

`Azure Monitor → Alerts`와 동일한 데이터를 이 Workbook 안에서 확인합니다.
모든 유형(Prometheus / Log Query / Metric)의 발생 알림이 **하나의 테이블**에 표시됩니다.

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or properties.essentials.targetResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity)
| extend alertState = tostring(properties.essentials.alertState)
| extend monitorCondition = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| summarize Count = count() by severity, alertState
| order by severity asc, alertState asc
content.title: Severity × 상태 요약 (Severity × State)

content.query:
alertsmanagementresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| where '{ResourceGroup}' in~ ('*', 'value::all') or isempty('{ResourceGroup}') or properties.essentials.targetResourceGroup =~ '{ResourceGroup}'
| extend alertName = tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule)
| extend severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity)
| extend signalType = tostring(properties.essentials.signalType)
| extend monitorService = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorService)
| extend monitorCondition = tostring(properties.essentials.monitorCondition)
| extend alertState = tostring(properties.essentials.alertState)
| extend firedTime = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| extend targetResource = tostring(properties.essentials.targetResource)
| extend description = tostring(properties.essentials.description)
| project
    ['Alert Name'] = alertName,
    ['Severity'] = severity,
    ['Signal Type'] = signalType,
    ['Monitor Service'] = monitorService,
    ['Condition'] = monitorCondition,
    ['State'] = alertState,
    ['Fired Time'] = firedTime,
    ['Target Resource'] = targetResource,
    ['Description'] = description,
    id
| order by ['Fired Time'] desc
content.title: 발생한 Alert 목록 (All Fired Alerts)
